# Eire Reborn - Update 6 on_actions, generated by tools/gen_script_celt.py
# Hooked into random_yearly_playable_pulse in eir_on_actions.txt
##########################################################################

# Once a year, every foreign county of a region under a Return of the Celts modifier has a 6% chance (1% x 5 + 1%) to take the ruler's culture.
eir_celt_conversion_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		OR = {
			has_character_modifier = eir_return_france_modifier
			has_character_modifier = eir_return_germany_modifier
			has_character_modifier = eir_return_spain_modifier
			has_character_modifier = eir_return_italy_modifier
			has_character_modifier = eir_return_galatia_modifier
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_modifier = eir_return_france_modifier }
			every_sub_realm_county = {
				limit = {
					empire = title:e_france
					NOT = { culture = root.culture }
				}
				random = {
					chance = 6
					eir_celt_convert_county_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_modifier = eir_return_germany_modifier }
			every_sub_realm_county = {
				limit = {
					empire = title:e_germany
					NOT = { culture = root.culture }
				}
				random = {
					chance = 6
					eir_celt_convert_county_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_modifier = eir_return_spain_modifier }
			every_sub_realm_county = {
				limit = {
					empire = title:e_spain
					NOT = { culture = root.culture }
				}
				random = {
					chance = 6
					eir_celt_convert_county_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_modifier = eir_return_italy_modifier }
			every_sub_realm_county = {
				limit = {
					empire = title:e_italy
					NOT = { culture = root.culture }
				}
				random = {
					chance = 6
					eir_celt_convert_county_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_modifier = eir_return_galatia_modifier }
			every_sub_realm_county = {
				limit = {
					kingdom = title:k_anatolia
					NOT = { culture = root.culture }
				}
				random = {
					chance = 6
					eir_celt_convert_county_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Once a year, the Forest Warriors' culture refreshes its blessing in every county of Britannia that the ruler holds.
eir_forest_dominion_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_ruler = yes
		eir_forest_culture_trigger = yes
	}
	effect = {
		every_sub_realm_county = {
			limit = { empire = title:e_britannia }
			add_county_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_forest_dominion_modifier
				years = 2
			}
		}
	}
}
